Sobre a investigação envolvendo Lulinha,: On the investigation involving Lulinha, Lula said his son opened his bank account and phone to be investigated and said: "In my world, nobody hides".
Sobre a pandemia, Lula citou 716 mil mor: On the pandemic, Lula cited 716,000 Covid-19 deaths, said Mais Médicos went from about 12,000 to 28,000 professionals and accused the previous administration of deteriorating federal hospitals in Rio.
Sobre as contas públicas, Lula rejeitou: On public finances, Lula rejected the risk of a fiscal crisis in 2027 and cited the forecast of a 0.1% primary surplus. He also criticized the Banco Central's autonomy.
Sobre as saidinhas, Flávio citou casos d: On the saidinhas, Flávio cited cases of victims of released inmates to say Lula prioritizes convicts and recalled Lula's veto of changes to the law, overridden by Congress.
Sobre economia, Flávio disse ao eleitor: On the economy, Flávio told voters that "this debt is not yours, this debt is the current government's" and asked: "Is food more expensive or cheaper?".
Sobre economia, Lula disse que é preciso: On the economy, Lula said it is necessary to "first get money circulating in people's hands" and recalled that the country paid off the IMF and built US$ 270 billion in reserves.
Sobre o Judiciário, Lula defendeu mandat: On the Judiciary, Lula defended fixed terms for STF justices and more participation by society in choosing them. On Jorge Messias, he said he will decide after the election whether to keep the nomination.
Sobre o fim da escala 6x1, Flávio disse: On ending the 6x1 work schedule, Flávio said the change should come with more public safety and purchasing power: "I don't want your day off to be a nightmare day, as is happening under this current government".
Sobre o primeiro turno, Lula disse que e: On the first round, Lula said he had expected a better result, but denied having underestimated Flávio. He said he will try to win back votes in the South, win in Minas Gerais and reduce Flávio's lead in São Paulo.
Sobre saúde, Lula disse que Flávio \"não: On health, Lula said Flávio "understands nothing about public health" and said: "In fact, I think he has never been to the SUS, he has never been to an UPA".
Sobre segurança pública, Flávio disse: \: On public safety, Flávio said: "Lula cares more about the rights of criminals than of victims".
Sobre segurança pública, Lula cobrou de: On public safety, Lula demanded that Flávio support the Public Safety amendment (PEC) and said that, if the Senate approves it, he will create "immediately the Ministry of Public Safety". He also said: "No state has managed to solve the public safety problem".
